notes: Fastned's published charge curve for the BMW i4 "83,9 kWh (2021+)" (200 kW) (read from the page's embedded chart data, one value per % SoC; every 5 % kept plus the peak). Fastned states curves show the car with the battery in optimal condition (about 30 °C) on its 300 kW-class chargers; cold or hot batteries charge slower. European market car. Peak 207.9 kW at 16 % is 4 % above the 200 kW rating (within the 5 % linter tolerance); the stepped 198.9 kW start and step drops at 17, 21, 26, 38 and 42 % are real features of the BMW curve, not smoothing. Source range 4-98 %. Same shape as the evkx.net table values seen in search excerpts (about 205 kW at 15-18 %, 107 kW near 50 %, 70 kW near 80 %), which is an independent-looking but possibly derived source and is only a sanity check. Applied to eDrive40, xDrive40, M50 (same 83.9 kWh pack, 200 kW rating in the spec batch).
